verdict.rationale: Polar's docs describe recurring subscriptions that renew automatically each billing period and create new orders (polar-docs-10). They document configurable proration, set as an organization default or per API call (polar-docs-12), and automatic seat proration (polar-docs-28). Dunning on failed renewals is documented with a published retry schedule (polar-supp-dunning), and subscriptions can be managed via the API, Customer State and the Customer Portal. missing for 10: no evidence of free-trial configuration, no explicit docs on upgrade/downgrade plan-change flows beyond the proration page, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
